_meta.source: Android Unity 2021.3.25f1 recorder built from extracted UILotteryPromotion prefab/bundles

notes: Large SSR / SSRUltimatePlusPU pink rectangle artifacts were present in older raw PNGs, so the bug was in the Unity recorder reconstruction, not MP4 encoding or browser playback.
Adding TextMesh Pro Essential Resources restored TMP runtime settings/fallback/style assets and removed the unmasked ColorGradient_* rectangle output.
Normalizing U+3000 ideographic spaces to ASCII spaces and forcing TMP mesh refresh removed remaining exact #ff00ff missing-glyph square components.
Threshold magenta remains in SSR/Ultimate variants because it is the intended gradient TMP glyph color, not connected square artifacts.

artifact_root_cause.cause: missing TMP runtime resources plus stale TMP mesh data for U+3000 ideographic spaces
artifact_root_cause.type: missing Unity component/resource and TMP fallback glyph issue
fix: Copied TextMesh Pro Essential Resources into the Android recorder project.
Replaced U+3000 and U+25A1 in TMP_Text contents before capture.
Called TMP_Text.SetAllDirty and TMP_Text.ForceMeshUpdate after normalization.

known_gaps: No real-game stage-gate capture comparison has passed yet.
Recorder still lacks game-specific MonoBehaviours such as Coffee.UIExtensions.UIParticle, UILotteryTextAnimation, WUIScripts.SimpleTweenTMPSage, CircleImage, and UnityEngine.Rendering.Volume.

Reference captures mix the preceding lottery movie silhouette/floor frames with the later UILotteryPromotion glyph layer; runtime tracing is still needed to confirm the exact stage boundary and composition.
SR_to_SSRUltimatePlusPU is available in the manifest, but the website payload still does not expose the real RandomStringRainbow outcome that selects that SR-start branch for pickup ArousalType >= 2.

variants.selection_note: Game reaches this branch only when arousal_type >= 2, the unit is pickup, and RandomStringRainbow returns the SR-start outcome. Current frontend payload does not expose that runtime random outcome.
